timeline.summary: Savra directs the planting of Golgari dead in a dark sanctuary.
timeline.quote: Plant our brethren here. This shall be our sanctuary.

citation.text: Dark Heart of the Wood (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Decamillennial, quietmen and Golgari Raiders led by Ludmilla attack the Center on Savra's orders.
timeline.quote: the Center was attacked by quietmen and Golgari Raiders led by Ludmilla

citation.text: "Center of Ravnica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golgari create a sinkhole that topples and shatters Zobor, also destroying the Tower of Thismi and damaging the Centerfort and Rokiric Pavilion.
timeline.quote: The Golgari created a massive sinkhole beneath him, causing the titan to topple and shatter across the surface of the mountain.

citation.text: "Center of Ravnica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra's death and Jarad's succession end the Golgari attack and force a withdrawal.
timeline.quote: Only the death of Savra and the succession of leadership to her brother, Jarad vod Savo , ultimately brought the Golgari attack to an end

citation.text: "Center of Ravnica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Svogthir, a devkarin necromancer turned lich, founds the Golgari Swarm as Ravnica's agricultural and reclamation sector.
timeline.quote: Founded by parun Svogthir , a devkarin necromancer -turned- lich , the Golgari Swarm functions as the agricultural and waste reclamation sector of Ravnican society.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra, helped by Szadek, takes control of the guild, resurrects Svogthir to overthrow the Sisters, and proclaims herself guildmaster.
timeline.quote: After this, Savra proclaimed herself as the new Golgari guildmaster.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Dissension, Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother Jarad, who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.
timeline.quote: In Dissension , Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother, Jarad , who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska takes control of the Golgari and becomes a voice for gorgons.
timeline.quote: When Vraska took control of the guild

citation.text: "Gorgon", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the New Phyrexian Invasion, compleated Vraska leads the compleated Golgari to the surface, targeting the Azorius.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Vraska was compleated and led the compleated Golgari Swarm to the surface

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Simic and Golgari activate Project Kraj, which absorbs cytoplasts across the city.
timeline.quote: Kraj began absorbing cytoplasts from across the city

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golgari unearth the Erstwhile's coffins and reanimate them.
timeline.quote: The Golgari have unearthed their coffins and reanimated them as part of the Swarm.

citation.text: "Elf", section "The Erstwhile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko surveys Sunhome from a rooftop and notes many dead soldiers loaded onto a Golgari corpse-hauler.
timeline.quote: Krenko began his surveillance on Sunhome, the imposing Boros guildhall.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Branko guards kneeling Golgari prisoners in the basement corridor of the Detention Compound while the first floor is lost to a revolt.
timeline.quote: some of the Golgari overwhelmed their captors and gained control of the first floor.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: Gebris taunts a Golgari prisoner and presses his boot to the man's face, provoking the prisoners to hiss and growl.
timeline.quote: Gebris took the toe of his boot and shoved it against the man's face

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: Gebris blames the Golgari for planning the raid, and Branko agrees to move the prisoners through the sunlit exercise yard to the South Block pens.
timeline.quote: "Let's take them through the exercise yard," Gebris urged.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: The prisoners surround Branko and free the gorgon to use her as a weapon.
timeline.quote: They were going to use her as a weapon.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: The gorgon tears at Branko's ear, the prisoners run free, and the guards lose control.
timeline.quote: Prisoners were running freely through the yard. They'd lost control.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: Sabast leads Domri deep into the Utvara and explains the Gruul view of death and nature.
timeline.quote: Look how nature responds,

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: At a Golgari archway Madarrak leaves Yzaak behind to guard the way and goes on with Castan.
timeline.quote: "Yzaak," Madarrak said, "wait here. Keep this way safe for us."

citation.text: "The Pursuit, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Varolz the Golgari maze-runner hungers to prove himself in battle.
timeline.quote: The Golgari maze-runner Varolz hungers to prove his fortitude in battle

citation.text: Crypt Incursion (Dragon's Maze, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A snapjaw enters the Golgari rot farm and fights and eats nonstop.
timeline.quote: A snapjaw made its way into the rot farm today

citation.text: "Paper Trail". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The snapjaw eats two workers and a handler, so the drudge-monitor plans to herd it into Izzet territory.
timeline.quote: Then it ate the handler.

citation.text: "Paper Trail". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Vraska takes control of the Golgari Swarm on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Vraska planeswalks to Ravnica and takes control of the Golgari Swarm .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska sings a Golgari song and talks with Jace before he falls asleep.
timeline.quote: The Golgari have little to be cheery about.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska singing a Golgari song aboard her ship.
timeline.quote: this Vraska was singing a Golgari folk song at the top of her lungs as her crew cleaned the ship.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska rises and the kraul become valued forces of the Swarm.
timeline.quote: with Vraska's rise, they became valued forces of the Swarm.

citation.text: Kraul Raider (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vraska orders the Golgari gates shut so the Underrealm can outlast the coming doom.
timeline.quote: Shut the gates. In the Underrealm we will outlast the coming doom.

citation.text: Golgari Guildgate (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vraska frees Jarad and becomes the new Golgari leader herself.
timeline.quote: She took Jarad out and became the new leader herself.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska kills Isperia and flees to Ixalan to escape Ral Zarek, leaving the Golgari factions fighting for supremacy.
timeline.quote: After Vraska killed Isperia , she planeswalked to Ixalan to escape from being killed by Ral Zarek leaving the various Golgari factions fighting for supremacy.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns to Ravnica, unites the Golgari and pledges the guild against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vraska united the Golgari once again and pledged the guild to the fight against Bolas.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Ajani's team, the Golgari evacuate many civilians to the tunnels beneath the city, safe from the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: With the help of Ajani and his team of planeswalkers, they were able to evacuate many civilians to the tunnels beneath the city, where they would be safe from the Dreadhorde .

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Vraska becomes Golgari guildmaster, the Kraul gain a more important role and become loyal to her personally rather than to the Swarm.
timeline.quote: After Vraska became guildmaster , the Kraul gained a more important role and became loyal to her personally instead of to the Swarm.

citation.text: "Insect", section "Kraul". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral's team clashes with the Golgari Swarm in the Undercity and he channels a leyline through his gauntlets, blasting the tunnels.
timeline.quote: funneling the entire energy of a leyline through his elemental gauntlets

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "Investigating the leylines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Golgari incursions threaten Zonot Four, Vannifar replaces Zegana as Prime Speaker and begins the Guardian Project.
timeline.quote: Zegana was replaced as Prime Speaker by Vannifar

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Golgari breach Zonot Four and a deep, slow war begins between Simic ecology and Golgari necromancy.
timeline.quote: has been breached and "infected" with Golgari life forms

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Zonot Four and the Golgari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska kills Jarad and establishes herself as Golgari guildmaster.
timeline.quote: Vraska killed Jarad and established herself as guildmaster

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golgari call upon an army that has slept beneath the city in preparation for the conflict all foresaw.
timeline.quote: the Golgari called upon an army that had slept for millennia beneath the city

citation.text: Awaken the Erstwhile (Ravnica Allegiance Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns and unites the Golgari, pledging them to the fight, and civilians are evacuated to the tunnels.
timeline.quote: Vraska pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas.

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns to Ravnica, unites the Golgari and pledges them against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vraska united the Golgari once again and pledged the guild to the fight against Bolas

citation.text: "Vraska", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Vraska at seventeen is held by an Azorius guard, and Ludmilla is killed while calling to her fellow Golgari prisoners.
timeline.quote: And then, with a wet slice and a heavy thump, she was not. I was the only gorgon left.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexians into the Golgari undercity, transforming her people into Phyrexians while Realmbreaker upends Korozda and cracks Svogthos.
timeline.quote: It is a hive in the truest sense, all pieces of a single purpose.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vraska orders her compleated Golgari to spill oil and blind the populace, leaving citizens collapsed in terror in the streets.
timeline.quote: "Spill as much glistening oil on the streets as you can,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Golgari fall to Phyresis faster than any other guild and swarm up from the Undercity to attack the surface.
timeline.quote: the Golgari fell to Phyresis faster than any other guild, experiencing near-total compleation, eventually swarming up through the Undercity to launch an all-out attack on the largely uncompleated surface.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gruul fight in Ravnica's defense in the Phyrexian invasion; Borborygmos gains respect and Nikya blocks the Golgari from the surface.
timeline.quote: Borborygmos' ferocious fighting earned him even more respect and loyalty.

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the invasion the other guilds denounce the Golgari, whose members are shunned and reviled.
timeline.quote: The Golgari were unanimously denounced by the other guilds, its members shunned and reviled.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Golgari faction leaders denounce Vraska and strip her of her title, leaving the guild with no acting head.
timeline.quote: the remaining leaders of the various Golgari factions, in a rare show of unity, resoundingly denounced her and stripped her of her title in the hope of distancing themselves from her acts.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Borborygmos rescues Fblthp from Phyrexianized Golgari, and they fight together.
timeline.quote: Luckily, he was rescued by Borborygmos, who happened to be smashing Phyrexians nearby.

citation.text: "Borborygmos", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Schism mutates the plague into an airborne plague wind; the guilds respond.
timeline.quote: mutating it to become airborne

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Fblthp runs away, lands on the frontlines, and is rescued by Borborygmos.
timeline.quote: he was rescued by Borborygmos

citation.text: "Fblthp", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guilds fight internally over whether to follow Bolas's influence; in the end five fall under his influence and five do not.
timeline.quote: In the end, five fall under his influence, and five don't.

citation.text: "Guilds of Ravnica block", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As a judge, Isperia issued a writ of mass arrest of Golgari members, and Vraska was apprehended.
timeline.quote: Vraska was amongst those apprehended

citation.text: "Isperia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Izoni is first to denounce Vraska as guildmaster and the guild's factions follow.
timeline.quote: Izoni was the first to denounce Vraska as guildmaster

citation.text: "Izoni", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Opposed to his twin Savra, Jarad allies with Agrus Kos and Fonn Zunich and upsets Szadek's coup at the Decamillennial Festival; after Savra dies he takes control of the Golgari Swarm.
timeline.quote: he took control of the Golgari Swarm

citation.text: "Jarad vod Savo", section "Bounty hunter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yanggu, Mu Yanling, Ajani and Huatli volunteer to protect and rescue civilians, evacuating many to the tunnels with Vraska and the Golgari Swarm.
timeline.quote: they were able to evacuate many civilians to the tunnels beneath the city

citation.text: "Jiang Yanggu", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kuba runs into the sewer and ends up in a Golgari Rot Farm, eating workers; the Golgari herd it into Izzet territory.
timeline.quote: To get rid of it, the Golgari herded Kuba into Izzet territory.

citation.text: "Kuba", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yanling helps protect and rescue civilians, evacuating them to the tunnels with Vraska and the Golgari.
timeline.quote: they were able to evacuate many civilians to the tunnels

citation.text: "Mu Yanling", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Nikya bottlenecks the Golgari Swarm from the surface with vine magic.
timeline.quote: Nikya was instrumental in bottlenecking the Golgari Swarm

citation.text: "Nikya", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golgari attack the Boros Legion's headquarters, starting a war; Dimir Lupul worms attack.
timeline.quote: The Golgari attack the Boros Legion ’s headquarters, and it's war.

citation.text: "Ravnica (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
